onboarding_message: Congratulations on starting your journey! These first five habits – creating an intro video, optimizing your channel with keywords, publishing your first video, stretching, and setting a weekly goal – will give you immediate momentum and lay a strong foundation for your YouTube channel success. Let's get started!
